name: Prancing Pony
description: The inn at the edge of town, where adventurers come to hear of work, and to take the jobs pinned to its notice board.

name: sealed door
description: A great door of dark stone, carved with dwarven runes and fast shut. No pick or spell will move it; it was made to open for one key alone.

name: barrow altar
description: A low altar of cracked stone, cold to the touch. Whatever was hallowed here was long ago profaned.

name: dwarven forge
description: An ancient forge of the Naugrim, its fire still burning in the rock. Here things of power were made, and here they may be unmade.

name: hermit's door
description: A narrow door in the rock, a lamp burning behind it. Someone lives down here, and has for a long time.

name: trapped apprentice
description: A young man pinned in a hollow of fallen rock, a basket of cave-moss clutched to his chest. He's been down here too long.

name: cold brazier
description: A great iron brazier on a stone foot, full of cold black ash. It was kept burning once.

name: burning brazier
description: A great iron brazier, burning high and bright with a fire that throws the shadows back.

name: Arcane Artificer
description: A narrow workshop of glass and brass, where SlatriBartSlow cuts sockets for gems into armour and blades — for a great deal of gold.
